title: Provision transport credentials and update mcp-gateway deployment configuration
description: Update the in-repo deployment assets of mongodb-mcp-server: the AWS Dockerfile/deploy path that sets MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http and MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0, and the Azure templates that default to NOAUTH. They must supply the new auth credential from an environment variable populated by the secret manager and must never set the opt-out flag. In the server.json registry metadata, mark the credential isRequired true and isSecret true. Create one credential per environment (dev, qa, prod) and per consuming agent client in the company secret manager. Record only the locators (vault path or env var name) in the sops-encrypted applications/mcp-gateway/credentials.json, never values. Hand the credentials to the agent clients that call mcp-gateway before enforcement. Constraints: sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess defines no deploymentWindows and env qa/prod have no changeFreeze; promote in environmentsOrder dev -> qa -> prod with approvalsRequired 1; do not enforce in prod before every known client is configured.
acceptanceCriteria: The merged diff shows the Dockerfile/deploy config reading the credential from an environment variable, with no literal credential and no opt-out flag. `git grep -n 'NOAUTH'` in the deploy templates finds nothing, or finds only disabled/documented-legacy entries.
server.json lists the credential setting with isRequired true and isSecret true.

applications/mcp-gateway/credentials.json passes `node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs applications/mcp-gateway/credentials.json` and contains a locator for the dev, qa and prod transport credentials, with no plaintext value.
A written list of the agent clients that use mcp-gateway in qa and prod, each confirmed as configured with its credential, is attached to the task evidence before prod enforcement.

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer checks the merged deploy/server.json diff, the validate-data output for credentials.json and the client configuration list. Expected: every deployment path requires the credential, no secret value appears in git or the workspace, and every listed client is marked configured for qa and prod.

rootCause.description: Deployment assets never provisioned an authentication credential: the AWS path binds 0.0.0.0 with no MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS and the Azure templates default to NOAUTH. Enforcing auth in code without provisioning credentials would break every client.
